business_rules.description: Category slugs are unique: creating a category whose slug already exists is rejected with 409.
Categories are paginated with limit (1 to 100, default 50) and offset (0 or more); the response is a JSON array of categories.
Reading a category that does not exist returns 404 with a JSON error body.
A product must reference an existing category (unknown category_id -> 404) and its SKU must be unique (duplicate SKU -> 409).
The optional category_id filter returns only the products of that category.
Reading a product that does not exist returns 404 with a JSON error body.
Only the fields sent in the body are changed (omitted or null fields keep their value); moving a product to a category that does not exist returns 404.
A deleted product can no longer be read: a later GET /products/{id} for it returns 404; deleting an unknown product returns 404.
